headlines.text: Major US outlets boycott shared Trump coverage in protest at media ban. Regular coverage of the president has been disrupted after he banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House.

Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC. Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.
Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings. The 2019 attacks were the deadliest the country had seen since the end of its civil war.

Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly. The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.
Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school. Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.
Outrage in India over viral video of teen molested and her friend beaten. Three minors were arrested after videos capturing the assault went viral in India, sparking anger.
Doctor in court to face Rwanda genocide charges in UK. Dr Vincent Brown was charged following a seven year British investigation into the 1994 killings.
Four dead after powerful Typhoon Dujuan lashes Japan. The storm pulled away from Japan after bringing heavy rains and strong winds to Tokyo and surrounding areas.
British man missing after diving into Lake Como to rescue teenager. The man had jumped in to save a father and son in difficulty in the water, local officials say.
Texas ICE shooting leaves Venezuelan DoorDash driver with bullet in his back, says lawyer. The delivery driver was transferred from a hospital to a detention centre, his lawyer tells US media.
Canadian province sues OpenAI over Tumbler Ridge school shooting. British Columbia has accused the company of failing to report the shooter's troubling interactions with ChatGPT to law enforcement.
Arteta agrees new deal with Premier League champions Arsenal. Mikel Arteta agrees an improved new contract with Premier League champions Arsenal.

Infantino says he is open to talks over Fifa reform. Fifa president Gianni Infantino has proposed an external review of how world football's governing body operates. shifting tone as he seeks support to stay on.
To Kill A Mockingbird first edition found in London charity shop. An original US edition of To Kill a Mockingbird is found in an Oxfam store in west London.

Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'. The chancellor has come under increasing pressure after resounding state election defeats, but says the results "go far beyond my own person"
How thousands of migrants stranded in Ceuta are surviving. Authorities estimate that at least 10,000 people remain in the enclave of Ceuta after a record surge in July.
Former ‘death squad’ leader appears in military trial in The Gambia. Sanna Manjang faces court for deserting army in 2017 after end of Jammeh's 20-year rule.
Trump speech inaudible as US networks boycott White House event. US President Trump unveiled a new White House helicopter pad as major US TV networks stayed away in protest.
Putin’s party wins supermajority in Russia’s parliamentary election. Victory of United Russia party strengthens Putin's hand even as the war with Ukraine grows more unpopular.
UN Chief Guterres calls for ban on ‘killer robots’. In this episode of On the Record, UN Secretary-General António Guterres calls for ban on autonomous ‘killer robots’.
US man convicted in 2023 shooting of three Palestinian students in Vermont. Jason Eaton faces up to life in prison after a jury rejected his insanity defence.
FAA halts flights to major US East Coast airports amid outage. FAA halts East Coast flights due to equipment outage, affecting major US airports like JFK, Newark, and Philadelphia.
Embattled Gianni Infantino says he is open to talks over FIFA reform. FIFA president proposes 'consultation' with members to reform world football governing body's decision-making process.
UK prosecutors charge first person for Rwanda genocide. Vincent Brown is 'alleged to have directed and incited acts of murder and genocide carried out by others'.
Protesters blockade Elbit Systems factory over Israel weapons supply. Nine protesters blocked access to Elbit Systems’ factory in Staffordshire by attaching themselves to five ‘lock-ons’.
Trump approval rating hits career low of 32% amid Iran war, high costs. Republican support for Trump dips to 73 percent, down from 82 percent, as war and inflation concerns dominate polls.
Photos: Gaza’s children return to class in tents and ruins. Gaza children return to classrooms after three years, facing challenges of damaged schools, tents, and scarce supplies.
Protesters march on Islamabad over soaring fuel prices. Pakistan’s Jamaat-e-Islami party has launched a protest march towards Islamabad over soaring fuel prices.
Ceuta solidarity shirt row: How the crisis engulfed Spanish football. Football has been dragged into growing tensions over the influx of migrants from Morocco to the Spanish enclave Ceuta.
Paramount settles with US states, union to win Warner Bros takeover. Ellison-led Paramount will avoid daily $7m fee if the $110bn Warner Bros merger closes by September 30.

Giants' season-opening high comes crashing down as Jaxson Dart's knee injury overshadows Rams' blowout win. Jaxson Dart's knee injury on "Monday Night Football" has the New York Giants awaiting MRI results after a brutal hit against the Los Angeles Rams.

Trump was a 'caged lion' roaring to return to WHCA Dinner ballroom after shooting, Leavitt says. Karoline Leavitt reveals Trump was "like a caged lion" demanding to return to the ballroom after shots were fired at the WHCA dinner in April.

Sylvester Stallone reveals what he said to Trump after surprise Hollywood ambassador appointment. Sylvester Stallone says he learned about Trump's Hollywood ambassador appointment while watching TV and later told the president it was impossible.

Mamdani tells Trump banned White House outlets are welcome at NYC meeting. NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani said the city welcomed all members of the media during his joint press conference with President Trump, who defended his decision to bar certain outlets.

Maryland hunter's alleged mistake leaves Delaware mother dead. A hunter faces manslaughter charges after allegedly mistaking a woman who was walking through a field for a deer while he was hunting in Delaware.

Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart suffers knee injury against Rams, possible MCL issue feared. Jaxson Dart injured his left knee on a high-low hit during Monday Night Football, and the New York Giants are now evaluating a possible MCL issue.

Socialist, communist groups coordinate, promote 'spontaneous' anti-ICE protests in Austin. Austin, Tex., ICE shooting protest was organized by socialist and communist groups within hours, not a "spontaneous" gathering as media reported.

Chris Murphy calls for 'regulating the internet' so people won't fall for a 'demagogue like Donald Trump'. Sen. Chris Murphy claimed regulating the internet could prevent Americans from falling for leaders like President Donald Trump by tackling loneliness.

How much rest should flight attendants get? New proposal ignites fight in the skies. A new FAA proposal would override state meal and rest break laws for flight attendants, but major airline unions say it lacks federal guarantees. An aviation industry expert weighed in.

Paris Hilton heartbroken over Presley Gerber’s death at 27 as she remembers his ‘gentle heart’. Paris Hilton, Brooklyn Beckham and Brody Jenner led tributes to Presley Gerber, remembering Cindy Crawford's son as a kind and gentle soul.

Eagles fan-favorite Zach Ertz returns to Philly amid injury concerns on offense. Zach Ertz returns to the Philadelphia Eagles after Dallas Goedert's MCL sprain, sitting just 11 catches from the franchise's all-time receptions record.

Puka Nacua officially out for Monday Night Football as Rams suffer major offensive blow. Puka Nacua's hip and groin injury leaves the Rams without their top target as Aaron Donald makes his season debut against the New York Giants.

Trumpeter Dr Jesse McGuire belts national anthem after instrument malfunctions in unforgettable MLB moment. The Arizona Diamondbacks' 2001 World Series anniversary featured a trumpet malfunction that turned into an unforgettable national anthem moment.

National Park Service director calls Yellowstone's wild bison recovery an 'incredible conservation story'. Over 600 Yellowstone bison have been transferred to 29 tribes across 13 states since 2019 through a landmark conservation program partnership.

Chiefs coach suggests Taylor Swift has sparked Travis Kelce's performance in first two weeks of season. Andy Reid says Taylor Swift likely "kicks him in the butt" as Travis Kelce's offseason work fueled his 101-yard, one-touchdown performance.

What the equinox 'henge' effect tells us about U.S. cities. The fall equinox, which arrives Tuesday in the U.S., brings shorter days, and chances to witness alignment between Earth and the sun. It's a modern version of ancient observances of a celestial shift.

Aviation regulators turn to AI to help manage the nation's airspace. The Federal Aviation Administration launched an ambitious $875-million-dollar push to make the U.S. airspace more efficient. But critics say it won't solve bigger problems with air traffic control.

Paramount makes concessions to salvage $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal. Paramount's owners have made concessions to 12 Democratic state attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that endangered the media company's bid for its larger Hollywood rival, Warner Bros. Discovery.

World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'. This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf. And, President Trump has proposed that his arch serve as a military complex.

Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on. While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

This farm raised thousands of pigs for slaughter. Now it's growing mushrooms instead. The U.S. gets nearly a third of its pork from Iowa. One family is making the switch from pigs to more sustainable specialty mushrooms and trying to show other pig farmers how they did it.

Germany's leader stands his ground after his party loses in state elections. German Chancellor Freidrich Merz conceded that the night spells "disaster" for the political center, but assured the public he'd push ahead with his federal agenda of tax and welfare reforms.

What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week. United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.

The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time. With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.. Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were being extradited to the U.S. on Sunday to face justice in Florida.
All Iranian airlines to be 'shut down' from Wednesday, Bessent tells CNBC. The Treasury Secretary said that Washington was pressuring Iran "like never before"
Here's who we know is going to the Trump-Xi dinner so far. Very little is known about which Chinese business executives, if any, are expected to attend.

Investors rush into India’s National Stock Exchange IPO at valuation multiple above Nasdaq. The $2.3 billion NSE IPO, India's largest public share sale issue so far this year, has drawn strong interest from investors, with bids of more than $10 billion.

Jamie Dimon says hyperscaler AI spending could hit $1 trillion next year. JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon says AI spending across the hyperscaler ecosystem could reach $1 trillion next year as investment continues to surge.

Tesla makes a move on Southeast Asia's largest EV market. A homegrown giant awaits. Tesla recently set up a subsidiary in Vietnam, taking a step toward a potential entry into a fast-growing EV market dominated by homegrown rival VinFast.

CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Five things to watch for the Trump-Xi summit. Many in China sound far more optimistic than those in the U.S. about the bilateral relationship, ahead of a highly anticipated summit this week.

Taiwan benchmark Taiex rises to record intraday high as tech stocks advance. Taiwan's benchmark Taiex rose to a record intraday high Tuesday, driven by gains in the tech sector, following an AI-driven rally on Wall Street.
CNBC Daily Open: All that glitters is another U.S.-China détente. Thursday will tell us whether Washington and Beijing can match Monday's market mood. Oil and chip stocks don't write trade deals.

Iranian President Pezeshkian to head to New York for UN meeting as Trump warns of no-deal consequences. Trump threatened to destroy Iran's economy or eliminate its leadership if Tehran doesn't strike a deal, complicating efforts at diplomacy.

OpenAI proposes development of global AI standards to guide alignment, RSI. Jacob Coxon's post nearly two weeks ago that Anthropic and OpenAI were "gambling with our lives" set off a global debate about AI safety.

Trump admin won't give AI leaders a 'liability shield,' Bessent tells CNBC. Bessent spoke with CNBC's "Squawk Box" about AI safety concerns and this week's summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and President Donald Trump.

Trump, Xi seek trade stability and deals, but AI, tariffs and Iran loom large. What to watch. Trump, facing low approval on the economy ahead of the midterm election, has an added incentive to emerge from the summit with China's Xi touting trade wins.
Bitcoin hits highest level since January at $86,000, as the market debates whether the 'crypto winter' is over. Bitcoin rose above $86,000 on Monday extending a rally over the past few days.
Retailer Revolve announces partnership with Donatella Versace. REVOLVE's partnership with Donatella Versace is the retailer's latest bid to create for young consumers.

Eli Lilly CEO says 700,000 new seniors have started GLP-1s after Medicare coverage, and 70% are on Lilly drugs. They're the latest metrics on how much the new Medicare coverage is expanding access to GLP-1 medicines since it launched in July.
